teaching.example: This bridge is an example of good design.
teaching.example_zh: 这座桥是优秀设计的一个例子。

extra_examples.en: Can you give me an example?

teaching.student_prompt: 看图读出 example，再用它说一个短句。
teaching.cloze: This bridge is an __________ of good design.
teaching.cloze_zh: 这座桥是优秀设计的一个例子。
teaching.note: 面向 KET 学生的原创短句；图片、释义与本课常用词义一致。

word_study.explanation_zh: 把 example 作为完整单词记住，再用 for example 建立实用联系。

family.connection_zh: for example 用来引出一个具体例子。

example.en: Some pets, for example dogs, need walks.
example.zh: 有些宠物，例如狗，需要散步。

challenge.prompt_zh: 请说出一个和 example 有联系的词或短语。

images.caption: This bridge is an example of good design.
images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: reusable classroom vocabulary photograph for Chinese primary-school KET learners, displayed large on a projector; landscape 3:2, ideally 1536x1024.
Style: beautiful, playful, realistic editorial photography; bright natural light; vivid but plausible colours; real materials and textures; uncluttered composition with one unmistakable main idea.
Composition: fully visible main subject, generous margins, clear at classroom distance.
Constraints: no embedded text, letters, labels, numbers, logos, watermarks, decorative frames, cartoons or clipart; safe child-friendly scene; correct anatomy and plausible scale.
Primary request: A teacher holds one model bridge as an example while several different bridge models sit on a classroom table.
